rows.grounds: first member of compound denoting disease type

items.question: Which specific winds and diseases are claimed to be eliminated by this practice?
premises: The practice also destroys the disease of leprosy.
Both eliminative effects are attributed to the same practice.
items.inference: Therefore, the described practice is held to remove eighty winds and leprosy.
uncertainties: The exact referent of the eighty winds in this context is not specified.
items.plain_english: It destroys the eighty winds, and it indeed destroys the disease of leprosy.
